name: Nuvdock – Bottom Action Bar
author: Shivam

sections.description:
Nuvdock displays a configurable fixed bar at the bottom of the site. The dashboard includes button and special-action editors, appearance and responsive controls, design presets, page and user visibility rules, optional WooCommerce behavior, and a live preview. Actions include URL, phone, email, WhatsApp, and section anchors, with a built-in icon set.

Settings are stored in the nuvdock_bba_settings option. On upgrade, existing sbb_settings data is copied only when the Nuvdock option is absent; the original option is retained. Links saved by version 2.0.0 in the actions format remain available in the restored button editor. WooCommerce is optional; no external services or third-party libraries are required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nuvdock-bottom-action-bar folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin ZIP from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Nuvdock – Bottom Action Bar.
  3. Open Nuvdock in the administration menu, enable the bar, and add links.
sections.faq:
What format do links use?

Enter one link per line as Label | URL. For example: Contact | https://example.com/contact/.

Does the plugin require WooCommerce or JavaScript?

No. The minimal version has no WooCommerce dependency and requires no frontend JavaScript.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • Restored the complete settings, appearance, responsive, display-condition, WooCommerce, and live-preview features.
  • Preserved settings migration from the former sbb_settings option and compatibility with version 2.0.0 actions.
  • Corrected plugin bootstrap, frontend/admin asset loading, and release packaging for WordPress.org SVN.

2.0.0

  • Introduced the Nuvdock plugin identity and a simplified configurable action list.
  • Added migration support for saved settings from the former option key.
